items.answer: Off-plan and ready property offer different trade-offs rather than a universally better choice. For villa buyers, set the expected off-plan handover against the immediate usability of ready property and the buyer's actual move-in or income timeline.
items.question: How do off-plan and ready property compare?

items.answer: Off-plan and ready property solve different buyer needs, so neither is universally better. Model deposits, instalments, financing and completion payments for both routes instead of comparing only the initial purchase price.
items.question: How do I compare off-plan and ready property?

items.answer: Neither off-plan nor ready property is automatically better for every buyer. Account for construction, delivery and specification risk in off-plan while checking condition, refurbishment and existing-building risks in ready property.
items.question: Which is better: off-plan or ready property?

items.answer: Buying off-plan can make sense when the project quality, price and buyer timeline justify the construction risk. Set the off-plan proposition against ready property and competing projects so future promises are evaluated against alternatives available today.
